market_outlook.short_term: Risk-off bias persists. Bond yields at decade highs pressure equities; Dow below key support. Iran conflict and yen intervention create volatility. Expect choppy, lower markets through September unless oil stabilizes and BOJ guidance calms FX. Earnings season (Q3) will be decisive for tech leadership.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex supercycle ($31.6T by 2050) supports structural tech growth. Bond yields at 5%+ offer attractive long-duration entry. Geopolitical fragmentation (Iran, EM debt) favors diversified, quality portfolios. Yen normalization and fiscal debates will define 2026 H2 macro regime.
